title: ApplyQuantityRequest
description: Payload Metabolism POSTs to {mycelium}/api/things/{thingId}/properties/{propertyPath}/{decrements|increments} on each simulation tick. Shape derived from vos.Service.Metabolism.Services.MyceliumClient.ApplyQuantityAsync.

amount.description: Quantity to apply; sign is determined by the URL path segment (decrements vs increments).

subjectName.description: Name of the subject thing performing the action; may be empty when unknown.

unit.description: Unit of the amount (e.g. 'kWh', 'litres'); may be empty when unset.
